title: Semi-supervised linear regression with missing covariates
summary: Missing values in datasets are common in applied statistics. For regression problems, theoretical work thus far has largely considered the issue of missing covariates as distinct from missing responses. However, in practice, many datasets have both forms of missingness. Motivated by this gap, we study linear regression with a labelled dataset containing missing covariates, potentially alongside an unlabelled dataset.
